payload.title: Upgrade Next.js to patch CVE-2026-23869 (RSC Server Function DoS)
payload.body:
**Local ticket id:** MP-SEC-CVE-23869-001  
**Suggested label (requires triage):** `security-cve-2026-23869`

## Summary

[CWE-770](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/770.html)-class issue: malicious HTTP requests against **App Router Server Function** endpoints can cause **excessive CPU use during deserialization**, leading to denial of service. This monorepo’s **pnpm catalog** currently resolves **`next`** to **^16.1.1**, which is in the affected range. Patch by upgrading to **`next` 16.2.3+** (or, if any consumer were on the 15.x line, **15.5.15+**). Do not rely solely on edge/WAF mitigations.

## Scope

- **In scope:** Bump `next` and aligned tooling (e.g. **`@next/env`** in the catalog if present) to a **patched** semver; refresh **lockfile**; run **workspace** checks; confirm **both** apps that use `next` (`apps/hermes/dashboard`, `apps/mediapulse/user-registration`) resolve the patched version.
- **Out of scope:** Broader dependency churn unrelated to this CVE; new WAF-only “fixes” without upgrading.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **`pnpm-workspace.yaml` catalog** (or equivalent) sets **`next`** to a version **≥ 16.2.3** (or **≥ 15.5.15** only if a package must stay on Next 15).
- [ ] If **`@next/env`** is catalog-managed, it is aligned with the chosen **Next** release line per upstream compatibility.
- [ ] **`pnpm-lock.yaml`** updated; **`pnpm why next`** (or install output) shows no resolved **`next`** in **GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3** affected ranges (**≥ 13.0.0 < 15.5.15**, **≥ 16.0.0 < 16.2.3**).
- [ ] **`pnpm code-quality`** passes at repo root after the upgrade.
- [ ] Smoke-test **App Router** apps (build or dev) if type/lint surface breaks from the minor bump.

## Dependencies

- **Depends on:** none
- **Blocks:** any production deploy that should not ship known **P0** DoS exposure for Server Functions

## References

- [GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-q4gf-8mx6-v5v3)
